features: The dev test deploy tells you when an update is available: style changes load live with no reload, and code changes reload with your game restored once you agree.
Safe dev deploys can replace compatible game logic between simulation ticks without reloading.
Saved battles now migrate safely across live game-state schema updates.
Reveal sandy coastal shallows and tune waves in the new Graphics settings tab.
Choose classic or ocean water and adjust view height, wave strength and animation speed in Graphics settings.
improvements: The money and power numbers in the phone status bar are larger and bolder, matching the taller bars.
Adjustable coastal shallows gradient length slider in meters in graphics settings.
Vehicles leave factory animations on the first clear outside tile; added garage door shading is removed.
Story intro narration stays clear above a substantially ducked music bed, which returns smoothly after the briefing.
Loading now advances smoothly based on recent startup times, wraps update notes, and uses the blurred landing-page battlefield backdrop.
M2 fires at one third of its former rate, with a 1% chance per hit of one crew casualty.
M2 autocannon impacts no longer leave ground decals.
Dynamic water gains rolling swells, sun glints, subtle crest foam and consistent wave size across displays.
Update notifications show readable full-width text below their action buttons.
bugfixes: CSS-only dev updates now reach open games reliably without a reload.
The money and power bars on phones now fill the whole status bar height instead of a thin strip, with the text centered.
Safe live updates no longer ask for a reload, and the portrait build bar now fits beside its wider category tab.
Smooth sharp tile edges at curved beaches and intersections of multiple biomes.
